# Standards map — which standard answers which question

Editions change. Before citing in a formal document, confirm the current edition and
whether a TS EN ISO adoption exists. This file lists *where to look*, not clause text.

| Question | Standard family |
|---|---|
| Enclosure ingress protection (IP) | IEC 60529 (EN 60529); IPX9K: ISO 20653 |
| Line types, views, sections on drawings | ISO 128 series |
| Dimensioning principles | ISO 129 series |
| Sheet sizes, title blocks | ISO 5457, ISO 7200 |
| General tolerances (linear/angular, geometric) | ISO 2768-1, ISO 2768-2 |
| Geometrical tolerancing (GD&T) symbols and rules | ISO 1101; datums ISO 5459; US practice ASME Y14.5 |
| Fundamental tolerancing principle (independence / envelope) | ISO 8015 |
| Welding symbols on drawings | ISO 2553 |
| Welded-assembly general tolerances | ISO 13920 |
| Surface texture | ISO 21920 series |
| Metric threads | ISO 261 / ISO 262 |
